african-plate.boundary_fact: splits from the Somali Plate along the East African Rift
african-plate.carries: Africa and adjacent Atlantic and Indian Ocean floor

antarctic-plate.boundary_fact: subducts beneath the South American Plate, uplifting Patagonia
antarctic-plate.carries: Antarctica and surrounding Southern Ocean floor

eurasian-plate.boundary_fact: collides with the Indian Plate, raising the Himalayas
eurasian-plate.carries: Europe and Asia, plus North Atlantic and Arctic seafloor

australian-plate.boundary_fact: subducts under the Sunda Plate at the Java Trench
australian-plate.carries: Australia, New Guinea and surrounding ocean floor

indian-plate.boundary_fact: collides with the Eurasian Plate, raising the Himalayas
indian-plate.carries: Indian subcontinent and part of the Indian Ocean floor

north-american-plate.boundary_fact: grinds past the Pacific Plate along the San Andreas Fault
north-american-plate.carries: North America, Greenland, and parts of Siberia and Iceland

pacific-plate.boundary_fact: grinds past the North American Plate along the San Andreas Fault
pacific-plate.carries: the Pacific Ocean basin, including Hawaii

south-american-plate.boundary_fact: is overridden by the subducting Nazca Plate, raising the Andes
south-american-plate.carries: South America and Atlantic Ocean seabed

arabian-plate.boundary_fact: collides with the Eurasian Plate, raising the Zagros Mountains
arabian-plate.carries: the Arabian Peninsula and Red Sea floor

caribbean-plate.boundary_fact: overrides the subducting South American Plate, forming the Lesser Antilles arc
caribbean-plate.carries: Central America and the Caribbean Sea floor

nazca-plate.boundary_fact: subducts under the South American Plate, raising the Andes
nazca-plate.carries: eastern Pacific Ocean floor off South America

philippine-sea-plate.boundary_fact: receives the subducting Pacific Plate, forming the Mariana Trench
philippine-sea-plate.carries: the Philippine Sea and Izu-Bonin-Mariana island arcs

scotia-plate.boundary_fact: slides past the South American Plate, opening the Scotia Sea
scotia-plate.carries: the Scotia Sea, Drake Passage and South Georgia

somali-plate.boundary_fact: splits from the African Plate along the East African Rift
somali-plate.carries: Madagascar, the Horn of Africa and nearby seafloor

sunda-plate.boundary_fact: is undercut by the Australian Plate at the Java Trench
sunda-plate.carries: mainland Southeast Asia, Borneo, Java and Sumatra

cocos-plate.boundary_fact: subducts beneath the Caribbean and North American plates at the Middle America Trench
cocos-plate.carries: carries only Cocos Island, off Costa Rica

juan-de-fuca-plate.boundary_fact: subducts under the North American Plate, forming the Cascadia subduction zone
juan-de-fuca-plate.carries: carries oceanic crust from the Juan de Fuca Ridge
